title: Stylish flamenco experience
text: Our whole family enjoyed this authentic flamenco performance in a stylish cocktail lounge setting
author: mtsull87

title: An hour of exciting flamenco
text: Unforgettable experience. A virtuoso guitarist as only flamenco guitarists can be, a singer with excellent interpretation, a dancer who moved us with the emotion she conveyed. We had ordered online entry plus a drink, both of which were very good, the show lasted an hour, as scheduled, for a few intimate guests just a meter from the artists. Recommended.
author: Matteo T

title: Cocktails and dreams
text:
David made the most amazing cocktails a true mixologist, super friendly by far the best bartender and cocktail bar in Seville.
Highly recommend
author: Macalhaurin

title: Nice flamenco
text: We really enjoyed the flamenco. However, it is a bit weird that it is not mentoined that you cannot choose which cocktail you would like (the advertisement did leave that impression on us whilst booking). Also, seating is a bit random (people arriving last minute got better Seats than people arriving early (they fill it up left to right).
